title: Halting with a specified answer
statement: Let $A$ be a program, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each decider and bit string, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. The run from configuration $a$ halts with answer $b$ if, for some natural-number time $T$, its state component is empty and its output component is $b$ at time $T$, and every configuration at a time $t<T$ satisfies $G$.
hypotheses_covered: oracle on deciders and bit strings
